# BB00540: Tablet to Nawruz Firuz {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Mighty, Most Exalted, Most Impregnable, Most Lofty, Most Holy

From God, exalted is He: Verily I am God, there is no God but Me. From the beginning that hath no beginning I have been an exalted Light. Verily I am God, there is no God but Me. Unto the end that hath no end I shall continue to be an exalted Light from the Creative Truth. Nay, O God! There is no God but Thee. From the beginning that hath no beginning Thou hast been an exalted Light. Nay, O God! There is no God but Thee. Unto the end that hath no end Thou shalt continue to be an illuminating Light.

We have sent down unto thee the verses and dispatched thee as a Remembrance from Our presence, for We have ever been mindful. Say: Proclaim "There is no God but God" and there is no Proof except ʿAli, and no Book after the Bayan from God, that ye may enter the Most Great Paradise. And say: Here assist God through the Great Name, and here through the Noble Name with mighty assistance.

Remember God before all those whose names thou hast mentioned with great glorification. Then return unto God, the Lord of all worlds, with beautiful return.
